en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph showing a classic park promenade with a colonnade (row of columns), likely part of a garden or landscaped grounds. Trees and a large house or pavilion can be seen in the background. The front side has the printed text 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Neue Anlagen.' The reverse side is styled as a classic divided-back postcard, with German-language text sections for correspondence and address, as well as the stamp of the Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont.
